contract.input: Permitted transcript, activity, attention, guide and overlay state.
contract.step: Type text in order; preserve one foreground interaction surface.
Center wider text blocks while aligning their text to the left.
Send pause and attention commands back to the core.
contract.invariant: Typing animation does not grant knowledge or advance logical rules.

test.when: The host changes attention while typing is in progress.
test.then: The eventual visible frame agrees with the core perception receipt.
